messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Newbie problem reading residuals....
parts:
Hi,

So the problem has to do with the text about Mplus diagrammer not be
parsed correctly. A quick hack for now, manually delete this text
from the output file:

DIAGRAM INFORMATION
Use View Diagram under the Diagram menu in the Mplus Editor to view
the diagram.
If running Mplus from the Mplus Diagrammer, the diagram opens automatically.
Diagram output
c:\users\administrator\dropbox\erik_eric\ipm\cpiaceplusuniqueresidsonly.dgm


then it reads in just fine. Hopefully I or Michael Hallquist can come
up with a patch for it in the near future.

Thanks for the example and report.

Cheers,

Josh

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Newbie problem reading residuals....
parts:
Hi Eric,

Thanks for letting us know about the bug in reading your output file. As Josh mentioned, we hadn't previously bumped into the DIAGRAM INFORMATION section in Mplus output, so the package inadvertently lumped this material into the RESIDUALS section (preceding), which caused the parser to crash in your case.

I have fixed the problem in the latest version of the package. We'll be releasing a more official update soon, but for now, you should be able to get the latest here:

install.packages("MplusAutomation", repos="http://R-Forge.R-project.org", type="source")

Best wishes,
Michael
